title: Capvision Partners HKEX IPO Remains Pending After Multi-Year Filing Process
summary: Shanghai-based Capvision Partners has reportedly filed multiple times for a HKEX listing since 2021, originally aiming to raise up to $300M. The IPO process stalled after offices were raided in late 2022 and state broadcaster CCTV aired a crackdown report in May 2023 accusing the firm of helping leak sensitive information. As of late 2025, the company remains privately held with no confirmed listing date. Note: specific details such as ticker number and valuation range are drawn from industry summaries (Inex One) rather than direct HKEX filings.
whyItMatters: Capvision's stalled IPO after regulatory crackdowns highlights the risks expert networks face in China's evolving compliance environment.
